data: Studying Mars atmospheric loss to solar wind; revealed Mars lost its atmosphere over billions of years
Added for PRD-023 Slice A — active Mars orbiter rendered as 3D glyph on /explore.
MAVEN at University of Colorado LASP
MAVEN — NASA NSSDCA (bus 2.3 x 2.3 x 2 m)
Mars atmospheric loss to solar wind

NASA's atmospheric orbiter at Mars — Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN. In Mars orbit from 2014 until contact was lost in December 2025, it studied how the planet lost its early thick atmosphere to solar wind erosion over billions of years.
